signals.title_orig: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
signals.summary_orig: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost .

signals.title_orig: Microsoft AI Releases Microsoft-Decision-1: A Qwen3.5-9B Decision-Scoring Model
signals.summary_orig: Microsoft has released Microsoft-Decision-1, a decision model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model that returns a calibrated probability for each fixed answer option instead of generated text. It is post-trained from Alibaba’s Qwen3.5-9B and available now in Microsoft Foundry and OpenRouter. . TL;DR What is a decision model?

signals.title: Alibaba Qwen lanza Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, un modelo de imagen 7B de 8 pasos
signals.summary: El equipo Qwen de Alibaba lanzó Qwen‑Image‑2.1‑Turbo, una versión acelerada que genera y edita imágenes en 8 pasos en lugar de 40, ofreciendo 5 veces menos denoising y una API alojada.
signals.title_orig: Alibaba Qwen Releases Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an 8-Step 7B Image Model
signals.summary_orig: Alibaba’s Qwen team has released Qwen-Image-2.1-Turbo, an accelerated checkpoint of its open-weight Qwen-Image-2.1 model. It generates and edits images in 8 denoising steps instead of the base model’s 40-step default.
